newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IMC Global estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IMC Global estimates cut.

text.p: -- Natwest Securities said it cut estimates for fertilizer producer IMC Global Inc for the company's fiscal second quarter to $0.53 a share from $0.68. The fiscal 1997 estimate was cut to $2.70 from $2.85.
-- Natwest said it cut the company's 1997 estimates because of high ammonia costs, lower margins on diammonium phosphate (DAP) and prospects for modestly lower DAP volume.
-- Natwest also cut its fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $3.20 a share from $3.50, reflecting an estimate that DAP prices would drop $10 a ton.
-- Still, the firm repeated its buy rating on the stock.

-- The calendar year 1996 "has turned into a disappointing year for demand growth," said Natwest. It said the lower-than-expected growth in part reflected wet spring weather in the United States, which held back crop planting, and a 20 percent drop in DAP imports to China.

-- "Looking forward, we have every expectation that export demand and volumes will rebound in 1997 -- to above 1995 levels," Natwest added. "We have heard reports that China is moving toward disbanding Sinochem's fertilizer import monopoly, which would probably improve the flexibility and eventual volume of imports."

-- "Despite these challenges, we continue to believe that this company and this industry can generate above-market earnings growth with profitable and disciplined reinvestment of cash flow," Natwest said.
-- IMC Global shares were down 1-1/4 at 38-1/2 at 1315 EST/1815 GMT.
